content: We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR spectra via tool. Then count distinct methyl signals (integrations?). The tool returns spectra as string, maybe includes integration? Not sure. Could also get carbon NMR and count signals around 10-30 ppm typical for methyl carbons. Let's request proton NMR.
